description:
Exposes Google Drive operations as agent tools.
List and search files, read metadata, download binary files and export native Docs/Sheets/Slides, create/update/copy/move files and folders, manage permissions (sharing), trash and untrash, and track changes. Supports My Drive and shared drives.
Public and external-domain sharing, and permanent delete, are gated behind explicit config flags. Authenticates via a Google service account or user OAuth.

adminEmail.description:
Enter the email address of a Google Workspace administrator.

This email should belong to a user with administrative privileges in your Google Workspace domain.
adminEmail.title: Administrator E-mail

customerId.description:
Enter your Google Workspace Customer ID.

This unique identifier is assigned to your organization by Google. It is used to specify the particular Google Workspace domain you want to manage.
customerId.title: Customer ID

serviceKey.description:
Upload the JSON key file for your Google Workspace service account.

This file contains the credentials necessary to authenticate API requests.
serviceKey.title: Service Account Key File

userToken.description: It is a long term token that allows you to get new access tokens to access the Google API.
userToken.title: Access Token

access.description: Drive scopes to request. readonly: list, read metadata, download, and export only. write: full read/write (create, update, copy, move, trash, folders, and sharing).
access.title: Access level
